description: This file defines template classes for managing web transfer operations, including client and server transfer types, within the Thunder Web namespace. It includes classes for handling transfer states, link management, hash calculation, and request/response processing for WebTransfer functionality.

classes.name: SingleElementFactoryType
classes.description: A template class that manages a single element of type ELEMENT, providing reference counting and access to the element.

classes.name: ClientTransferType
classes.description: A template class managing client-side web transfer operations, including state management, request handling, and transfer lifecycle for a specified LINK and FILEBODY.

classes.name: ServerTransferType
classes.description: A template class managing server-side web transfer operations, including request processing, authorization, and file handling for a specified LINK and FILEBODY.

methods.name: StartTransfer
methods.description: Initiates a transfer with a given request.

methods.name: CollectInfo
methods.description: Collects information from a source URL.

methods.name: Upload
methods.description: Uploads a file to a destination URL.

methods.name: Download
methods.description: Downloads a file from a source URL to a destination file.

methods.name: Setup
methods.description: Virtual method to set up remote URL parameters.

methods.name: InfoCollected
methods.description: Virtual method called when info is collected.

methods.name: Transferred
methods.description: Virtual method called when transfer is complete.

methods.name: Authorize
methods.description: Virtual method to authorize a request.

methods.name: LinkBody
methods.description: Handles attaching a body to a response or request.

methods.name: _CalculateHash
methods.description: Calculates hash for a request or response if applicable.

methods.name: _ValidateHash
methods.description: Validates the hash signature if applicable.

methods.name: EndTransfer
methods.description: Handles completion of a transfer, updating state and invoking callbacks.
